name: Mikey Musumeci Berimbolo System
description: Mikey Musumeci’s Berimbolo foundation course develops stacking, pulling, twister-hook, uninverting and top-bolo variations.
summary: Stacking, pulling and twister-hook variations within Musumeci’s berimbolo foundation course.
overview: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation develops the basic inversion into several ways of advancing position. Mikey Musumeci covers stacking and pulling variations, twister hooks, uninverting and top-bolo situations. This guide emphasizes those variations for someone interested in what follows the initial berimbolo entry.

related_content.name: Berimbolo
related_content.relationship: Overview of the same course emphasizing double-pull positioning, grips and inversion foundations.

products.title: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation
products.blurb: The foundation release includes both initial berimbolo entries and stacking, pulling and top-bolo variations.
products.best_for: Berimbolo players interested in positional options after the initial entry.

fits: You want stacking and pulling variations beyond the basic berimbolo.
You want coverage of twister hooks, uninverting and top-bolo situations.

includes: Stacking and pulling variations, including combinations between them.
Twister hooks, shoulder and collar controls, and uninverting to mount or the back.
Top-bolo material and connections to passing or arm-triangle attacks.
limits: This is the same eight-volume Part 1 foundation release featured in the Berimbolo guide, not a later installment or a separate product.
